messages:
Priya: opening change window now. coordinated canary for router/api/runtime/console. pins: router@1.0.2, api@1.9.0, runtime@2.4.0, console@3.1.0-canary

deploy-bot: enqueue: wave-alpha -> router-staging + api-canary (8% traffic) + runtime-pool-b (min 2). estimated 20m for wave-alpha health checks.

Tom: FYI console canary exposes new feature flags. set console.write_mode=off during canary so UI is read-only.

Diego: defining rollback triggers here: if api_error_rate increases by 4 percentage points over baseline for 3m OR api_p95 > 700ms for 5m => pause and escalate. KV eviction >2.5x baseline is immediate stop.

Priya: adding traffic-split policy: router will sprinkle calls to fallback-model (redwood-fallback-v1) when api_errors > 2% to reduce customer impact.

sre-bot: paging thresholds created: api_p95>650ms, api_errors>2.5%, runtime_kv_evictions_rate>1.5x. Pager: #eng-oncall + @diego.

Tom: ops tweak: bump runtime pool-b min to 3 to reduce cold starts for canary. undo after window.

deploy-bot: wave-alpha completed: health OK, traffic now 8%. scheduling wave-beta in 28m (40% traffic).

Priya: runbook snippet for staged rollback (copy paste):
```
# Staged rollback to reduce routing disruption
1) router: revert to tag previous -> `./deploy set router --tag previous`
2) API: rollback to api@1.8.x -> `./deploy set api --tag 1.8.5`
3) runtime: restore pool snapshot -> `runtimectl restore --pool pool-b --snapshot snap-2026-03-19`
4) console: disable canary routes -> `consolectl route disable canary`
Note: follow this order to avoid request blackholes.
```

Diego: please also ensure release notes mention the new routing hedge and console read-only during canary. docs-bot: link?

docs-bot: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-22-staged-release-notes added. includes pin matrix and rollback steps.

Priya: cadence: wave-beta 40% for 25m, final wave GAMMA 100% after manual approval from lead-eng. If any hard-stop (KV eviction spike or sustained p95 breach) we abort and follow staged rollback.

Tom: will monitor `runtime.kv_eviction_rate`, `api.error_rate`, `router.conn_fails`. adding temp dash widgets.

diego: minor: if we hit api_errors between 2% and 4% for short bursts, deploy-bot should automatically throttle outgoing new sessions for 10m (soft backoff). config: `deploybot.throttle_on_error=true`

deploy-bot: wave-beta started -> 40% traffic. health check window active.

Priya: change window ends 2026-03-22T02:00Z. autoscale rollback to previous min/max scheduled at window end.

sre-bot: approval flow reminder: lead-eng + oncall signoff required for final 100% rollout. emergency SRE rollback allowed if customer SLA impacted. Ping @Priya + #eng-oncall to escalate.

Tom: monitoring steady. no eviction spikes. preparing to approve final wave pending lead-eng ok. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: wave-beta success -> 40% stable. final approval pending manual trigger.

Priya: will request lead-eng approval in 15m. thanks everyone for quick checks.
